name: shot-team
title: Zero NPCs
sub: Everyone at a desk is a real Claude Code session in a real terminal. Thinking, blocked, needs you: the tag is the truth.

name: shot-floor
title: Walk the floor
sub: W, A, S, D through your own company. Meeting room, server room, a wall of live terminals.

name: shot-quests
title: Quest board
sub: Hand out tasks, or let the team pick them up. A quest is DONE when the office itself ran the tests and merged it.

name: shot-command
title: Command center
sub: Who needs you, who is blocked, which machine is sweating. Top-down, like a proper strategy game.

name: shot-whip
title: Crack the whip
sub: Press R. A crack, a flinch and a “jao!”. It does nothing at all for productivity. It stays in.

name: shot-break
title: Break room
sub: A hi-fi that plays internet radio for the whole office, a TV with a real browser in it, a sofa nobody has earned.
